messages.content: Output ONLY valid JSON. No explanation, no markdown fences, no commentary.

Create a JSON object representing a deployment event with this nested structure:
- id (string, UUID format)
- timestamp (string, ISO 8601)
- environment (string: "production", "staging", or "development")
- service (object):
  - name (string)
  - version (string, semver)
  - image (string, Docker image tag)
- deployer (object):
  - username (string)
  - email (string)
- changes (array of objects, at least 2):
  - each with: file (string), type (string: "added"|"modified"|"deleted"), lines_changed (integer)
- rollback_available (boolean)
- health_check_url (string, valid URL)

Use realistic sample values.
